overlap.historical_definition: matches in the earlier selected/engineered predictor representation
overlap.current_definition: exact float64 equality across the ten raw serving measurements; hash membership verified by equality join
overlap.identity_interpretation: feature equality alone does not establish identical physical connections

provenance.connection_identity: CSV-local id is a row identifier; no verified physical-connection key
supported_splits: attack-family withholding with complete signature exclusion
provenance.stronger_source: UNSW publishes original PCAP/Argus/Bro files, event/ground-truth records and full CSVs; acquire verified mapping before time/host/capture splits

uncertainty.method: 95% percentile bootstrap resampling entire measured-input signatures with replacement; row-weighted estimates
uncertainty.seeds: benchmark 1000+scope index, grouped 2000+split seed, family 3000+family index; categories add category index+1
uncertainty.conditional_on: fixed fitted pipeline, fixed validation/calibration threshold, observed traffic and signature definition
uncertainty.limitations: does not include refitting/model-selection/threshold-selection uncertainty or latent capture/host dependence; small groups and boundary rates may be degenerate; no population or deployment guarantee

metric_definitions.precision_recall_f1_fpr: binary attack detection at each frozen threshold
metric_definitions.pr_auc: trapezoidal area of precision-recall curve, initial recall=0 precision=1, tied scores move together
metric_definitions.average_precision: non-interpolated precision weighted by recall increments; reported separately from trapezoidal PR-AUC
metric_definitions.category_comparison: one attack category versus normal rows in the same scope; other attacks excluded; FPR uses shared normal rows; precision/PR-AUC depend on this constructed prevalence
metric_definitions.undefined: null for metrics without required classes/denominators; intervals null with insufficient valid bootstrap draws

protocol.design: clone fixed previously selected serving architecture and all parameters; fit only on fitting rows; tune threshold only on separate calibration; no outcome-driven model changes
protocol.fold_assignment: 5 stratified signature folds; fold0 evaluates, fold1 calibrates, folds2-4 fit; family runs additionally exclude all family signatures from fit/calibration
protocol.interpretation: additional internal robustness evidence on previously inspected data; not a newly untouched external final test
